apply_tp_to_transformer: apply tensor parallelism to a Transformer model by sharding attention and feed-forward layers across GPUs
init_dist_process_group: initialize the NCCL distributed process group for multi-GPU tensor parallelism with a 6-hour timeout
apply_tp_linear_sharding: shard a linear layer weight matrix column-wise or row-wise across the world size for tensor parallelism
apply_tp_ffn_sharding: apply tensor parallelism to a FeedForward module by sharding w1, w3 colwise and w2 rowwise with all-reduce
apply_tp_attention_sharding: apply tensor parallelism to an Attention module by sharding wqkv colwise and wo rowwise with all-reduce
